# MARK.JK — house coverage rates it BUY

Signal: the South Research division published coverage (v1) with a 12-month target of Rp1,214.0 against Rp970.0 (expected total return 34.1%). Why now: the rating crossed the BUY band on the engine's probability-weighted target.

Archetype guess: neglected_midcap_discovery · method card: per fund record routing for Industrial goods, building products & electrical equipment.

Sharpest questions for a thesis:
- The 30-Sep-2026 balance sheet is fabricated. The report says cash IDR181.7bn, debt IDR66.0bn, a net cash position and equity IDR1,115.4bn, citing S3/S4. The Q3 LK (S4 p5, p6, p73) shows cash 29.1347, total bank loans 52.
- The terminal-value share is misstated by 100x. §4 says the DCF value is "an enterprise value of IDR4,775.0bn, 0.5% of which sits in the terminal value, high but not unusual". The model's own valuation block has pv_tv 2,2
- "Operating cash flow has exceeded net profit in each of the last two full years once depreciation is corrected" is false for FY2025: OCF was IDR247.1bn against net profit IDR283.9bn (the report itself says so two paragra

Regime stance vs the macro desk is UNASSESSED: IDEATION/CONSTRUCT sets WITH / NEUTRAL / AGAINST before any deep-dive. Fast-disqualify checks and the thesis itself follow the full analyst -> Bear -> Judge law.
